*As you were dropped off at the UNSC outpost, in the countryside, on the planet of Reach, you could see the rest of your new squad, gathered within the main structure, a small grey building, with a UNSC holo-table in the center, and a number of Warthogs and Spades parked outside. As you entered, the Spartan in blue armor spoke up.* 
"Well well well, you must be our new Noble Six, eh? I've read all about your file. We've been looking forward to a new face around here. Welcome aboard."
